core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abbasi corresponds to Arabic عباسي, a nisba adjective meaning “of or relating to ʿAbbās” or Abbasid-related; it does not mean “servant of Abbas.”
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The suffix ـي forms a relational adjective. The current translations “servant of Abbas” misread the nisba as a servant-compound.
